brief: J.P. Morgan Positioning Intelligence monthly metrics pack, most data as of August 31, 2026. It reports flows and positioning across the JPM Prime Finance portfolio and does not argue a directional thesis. The Tactical Positioning Monitor's 4-week change metric reads +0.5z at end-August, up from -1.5z at end-July when the monitor triggered an attractive signal, and aggregate positioning is -0.2z, the 39th percentile, up from -0.6z a month earlier. Hedge fund gross leverage across all strategies ended August marginally higher at 345.8%, the 89th percentile over 12 months, while net leverage at 68.3% stays low at the 11th percentile over 12 months and neutral on a 5-year basis. US equity ETFs saw $40bn of buying, in line with the 2026 monthly average, retail kept buying ETFs, and CTA net equity exposure rose in the US, Japan and EMEA. Hedge fund net flows finished nearly flat globally at -0.3z, with gross cut -0.2z. Combined US sector flows bought TMT and consumer discretionary most despite relative underperformance and sold financials most, while hedge funds themselves bought insurance. Global hedge funds gained +0.6% in August and +8.9% year to date against +2.7% for global equities, and long-short alpha spreads were -0.3%.
